# Lyrenza Buenos Aires Puerto Madero

## Permanent property facts

Lyrenza Buenos Aires Puerto Madero is in Buenos Aires, Argentina, in the South America region.
Facilities: Indoor pool; tango lounge; steak restaurant; river views. Pool or water-facility hours: 06:00-22:00.
Parking: Valet parking; ARS 18000 nightly. Transportation: Waterfront promenade is adjacent.

Accessible rooms include step-free routes and must be requested before arrival. Family
services and pet arrangements are confirmed with the reservation team.
